title: Kitten eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='25' ry='20' fill='#ffa94d'/>

  <path d='M32 60 Q50 55 68 60' stroke='#e07b28' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M73 78 Q92 76 88 58 Q86 50 80 54' stroke='#ffa94d' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <circle cx='80' cy='54' r='4' fill='#ffe0b3'/>

  <circle cx='50' cy='42' r='21' fill='#ffb75e'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M33 28 L30 10 L46 22 Z' fill='#ffb75e'/>
  <path d='M67 28 L70 10 L54 22 Z' fill='#ffb75e'/>
  <path d='M35 26 L33 16 L43 22 Z' fill='#ffd6a5'/>
  <path d='M65 26 L67 16 L57 22 Z' fill='#ffd6a5'/>

  <path d='M42 24 L45 20' stroke='#e07b28' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 22 L50 18' stroke='#e07b28' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='51' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffe0b3'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <path d='M47 47 L53 47 L50 50 Z' fill='#ff7b9c'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='54' rx='4.5' ry='3' fill='#8a4b63'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='2.5' ry='1.4' fill='#ff9db5'/>

  <path d='M38 49 L25 46' stroke='#fffbe6' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 52 L25 53' stroke='#fffbe6' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <path d='M62 52 L75 53' stroke='#fffbe6' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <ellipse cx='38' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd6a5'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='82' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#ffd6a5'/>

  <ellipse cx='66' cy='62' rx='9' ry='4.5' fill='#6ec6e8'/>
  <path d='M74 62 L82 57 L82 67 Z' fill='#4aa8cc'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='61' r='1.4' fill='#2b4a5c'/>
  <!-- paw holding the fish -->
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='70' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#ffd6a5'/>
